test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. The lifeguard rescued Molly and her family. **

options.text: Molly and her family were rescued by a lifeguard.
Molly and her family were being rescued by a lifeguard.
Molly and her family is rescued by a lifeguard.
Molly and her family was rescued by a lifeguard.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Molly and her family were rescued by a lifeguard.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Identify the Subject, Verb, and Object in the Active Voice Sentence:
 
 
• **Subject**: The lifeguard
 
• **Verb**: rescued
 
• **Object**: Molly and her family
 
 
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The object "Molly and her family" from the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• "**were**" is the appropriate form of the verb "**to be**" in the past tense.
 
• "**rescued**" is the past participle form of the active verb "rescued."
 
• "by a lifeguard" is included to specify the agent (the lifeguard) who performed the action.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.
